newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Guthrie alters shareholding in unit.
newsitem.headline: Guthrie alters shareholding in unit.

text.p: Guthrie GTS Ltd said on Friday it will change its shareholding in associated company Neldon Ltd due to the inclusion of a new partner.
Neldon is a joint venture company managing the development of a luxury hotel apartment complex in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, to be known as Micasa Cambodiana Hotel Apartments.

Guthrie said in a statement it would dispose of all its shares in Neldon, in part to new partner TTD Sdn Bhd (TTD) and in part to Federated Overseas Ltd (FOL), the company's 50 percent-owned associated company.

It said Guthrie would hold an eventual effective equity interest of nine percent in Neldon through FOL. The company's equity investment in Neldon would eventually be increased from US$1.0 million to US$1.13 million on the basis that the projected total costs of the development will be approximately US$25 million.
Guthrie said that even though Neldon would cease to be its associate, it will equity-acount Neldon's performance through FOL.
The change was not expected to have any material financial impact on the Guthrie Group for the current financial year ending December 31, 1997, it said.
